title: Claims says your bank “failed verification”
scenario: A caller claiming to be from your travel insurer knows your claim amount and date. They say the payout failed and ask you to install a “secure verification” app so an agent can fix the bank details with you.

answers.A: Ask the caller to note the issue on your claim, then verify it later through your insurer account.
answers.B: Install the app but do not grant screen-control permission unless the insurer account shows the same request.
answers.C: End the call and open the insurer’s app/site or call the number on your policy to check the claim and payout details.

explanation: Remote-access tools can turn a plausible service call into account theft. Payout changes should be verified in the insurer’s established channel.
proTip: No claim is improved by giving a stranger control of your screen.
